Remote / opaque calls need review</font>" style="rounded=1;arcSize=14;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fontFamily=Helvetica;fontSize=16;fillColor=#FFF7ED;strokeColor=#F59E0B;fontColor=#78350F;strokeWidth=1.5;spacing=12;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="1190" y="900" width="570" height="145" as="geometry"/></mxCell> <mxCell id="support-label" value="STATE, APPROVALS & VERIFICATION" style="text;html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;fontFamily=Helvetica;fontSize=16;fontColor=#0F172A;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;spacing=0;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="40" y="1080" width="900" height="28" as="geometry"/></mxCell> <mxCell id="state" value="<b>Session state and logs</b><br><font style="font-size:13px">Bounded prompt history + untrusted tool results<br>Locked context and download state<br>reviews.json + legacy approvals + private log</font>" style="rounded=1;arcSize=14;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fontFamily=Helvetica;fontSize=16;fillColor=#F0FDFA;strokeColor=#14B8A6;fontColor=#134E4A;strokeWidth=1.5;spacing=12;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="40" y="1130" width="535" height="125" as="geometry"/></mxCell> <mxCell id="approval" value="<b>Codex in-session exact-action grant</b><br><font style="font-size:13px">Client form response only · no chat approval<br>Bind host + session + cwd + tool + all arguments<br>Single use · 15 minutes · recheck policy on retry</font>" style="rounded=1;arcSize=14;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fontFamily=Helvetica;fontSize=16;fillColor=#FFF7ED;strokeColor=#F59E0B;fontColor=#78350F;strokeWidth=1.5;spacing=12;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="615" y="1130" width="535" height="125" as="geometry"/></mxCell> <mxCell id="tests" value="<b>Verification layers</b><br><font style="font-size:13px">test_gate.py: core behavior and merge rules<br>probe_corpus.py: command classification + noise<br>Adapter / plugin tests. Hermes worker-thread dispatch<br>e2e/: real CLI + scripted model</font>" style="rounded=1;arcSize=14;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fontFamily=Helvetica;fontSize=16;fillColor=#F8FAFC;strokeColor=#CBD5E1;fontColor=#334155;strokeWidth=1.5;spacing=12;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="1190" y="1130" width="570" height="125" as="geometry"/></mxCell> <mxCell id="runtime" value="<b>Shared parser runtime · explicit setup only</b><br><font style="font-size:13px">bootstrap.py --setup: private virtual environment + pinned tree-sitter / Bash grammar<br>Runtime key = Python major/minor + requirements hash. Reuse across hosts with the same key.<br>Tool hooks never install packages. Missing runtime / parser → denial after the launcher starts.</font>" style="rounded=1;arcSize=14;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fontFamily=Helvetica;fontSize=16;fillColor=#F0FDFA;strokeColor=#14B8A6;fontColor=#134E4A;strokeWidth=1.5;spacing=12;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="40" y="1290" width="1720" height="100" as="geometry"/></mxCell> <mxCell id="boundary" value="BOUNDARY OS isolation is still required against an adaptive same-user agent.
